r5_clearway_c.desc: AS 1743 clearway symbol (red rounded square, white C), here 140 square with C 110 D

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R5-SA46-2 225 x 450 (2017), R25, red on white, no border. Clearway symbol 140 square with C 110 D (42/140/43), 15 from the top — the AS 1743 R5-50 symbol at 140. Two time lines, tops 210 and 270 (50 high, 10 apart), MON - FRI baseline 350 (30 below), arrow 32 high 13 from the bottom (100 from the MON - FRI baseline to the edge; 249 from the symbol to the arrow). Time lines as the national R5 time legends: hour numerals 50 E, minutes '30' in 30 C top-aligned, AM / PM 15 E bottom-aligned (30 + 5 + 15 = 50), dash 15 x 4; the horizontal positions are not dimensioned beyond '195 MAX.' (centred) and are measured from the sheet. MON - FRI 20 E, 141 overall (42/141/42), dash 14.5 x 3.3 measured. The times are the sheet's example; only the example is generated. Arrows are the AS 1743 R5-14 (double, 155 x 32) and R5-16 (single, 125 x 32) open-chevron arrows the sheet cites, drawn as polygons with the national dimensions (shaft 12, head 42 long x 32 wide, barbs 12 thick).
